teaching.en: I have taken coach K8 before. It was cancelled at 09:10, and I have been waiting since 08:30 with ticket P14. I need to arrive before 15:00 with a bicycle. Route A arrives at 14:20 and accepts bicycles; B arrives at 15:25; C arrives at 13:50 but rejects bicycles. I requested A because it meets both restrictions.
